dct_title_s: Map showing proposed opening of Edmund Boulevard between East 36th Street and East 44th Street, Minneapolis, Minnesota : scale 1 inch = 200 feet, April 19, 1925
dct_alternative_sm: Map showing proposed opening of Edmund Boulevard between East 36th Street and East 44th Street, Minneapolis, Minnesota : scale 1 inch = 200 feet, April 19, 1925
dct_description_sm: Includes a letter to the Minneapolis City Council from agents of the University of Minnesota, the Sheltering Arms, and the Lutheran Children's Friend Society. The petitioners request that the indicated section of street be vacated.; Marked in pencil on map and letter: ""2091-010"".; Stamped at bottom right of map: ""May 20 1925"".
